description: A dep-vuln-policy artifact defines blocking thresholds, remediation SLAs, and exception handling rules for dependency vulnerabilities across all project ecosystems.

rules.description: Policy must declare project, ecosystems array, and thresholds with all four severity levels.
thresholds.critical.action must be 'block', 'fail', or 'error' — critical vulnerabilities must prevent deployment.
thresholds.high.remediation_sla_days must be declared and must not exceed 14 days.
Every exception entry must declare exception_record_ref and a meaningful justification.
Every ecosystem object must declare scanner, tool, or audit_command.
